findings.ac: Stress Cases: 24-row seed hazard prevented by shipping seed correction and row removal in the same artifact
findings.text: The seed correction is in schema.sql but the legacy-row removal (DELETE FROM job_functions) is only in migration_bt168_job_functions_canonical.sql, a separate file. Re-running schema.sql alone on a legacy-seeded database still yields 24 rows. The schema.sql comment warns about this, but no test or code prevents it, and BT171_TaxonomySeedMigration.test.js never covers that case.

findings.ac: Invariant 11 gate + manual HITL verification (paste of select id ... order by sort_order, exact-equality comparison to CANONICAL_JOB_FUNCTIONS/CANONICAL_SECTORS)
findings.text: No test, script or doc in the changed paths produces the live-vs-canonical comparison or the fresh-apply verification. The evidence depends entirely on PR-body content that is not in the packet. BT171_TaxonomySeedMigration.test.js is static text parsing, not an apply against a database, so the 'fresh apply yields exactly twelve rows' and 'reaches the VERIFY block' ACs are proven only by seed-text equality.
